job.title: Senior .NET Developer [m/w/d] mit Schwerpunkt CMS, DXP und E-Commerce | Aviation & Retail (m/w/d)

tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java & Spring | Enterprise Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior .NET Developer [m/w/d] mit Schwerpunkt CMS, DXP und E-Commerce | Aviation & Retail (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: Bringing over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply my robust background in Java, Spring, and scalable backend integrations to CGI's ambitious digital projects in aviation and retail. I am eager to contribute my technical depth and end-to-end delivery expertise to your team.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce Platforms
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management for global platforms.

bullets.label: API & Integration Architecture
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and custom Hotfolders and DataHub pipelines to ensure seamless data synchronization across complex PIM, ERP, and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Performance & Stability
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, while executing CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on cloud portals.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Worked closely with business stakeholders and product owners to analyse requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and support user acceptance testing.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience aligns with CGI's needs.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior .NET Developer [m/w/d] mit Schwerpunkt CMS, DXP und E-Commerce | Aviation & Retail (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Mit über 5 Jahren fundierter Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Betreuung großer E-Commerce-Plattformen für Unternehmen wie Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich umfassendes technisches Know-how in Java, Spring und skalierbare Backend-Architekturen mit zu CGI. Gerne möchte ich meine Expertise in komplexen Systemintegrationen und E-Commerce-Projekten für den Bereich Aviation & Retail einbringen.

bullets.label: E-Commerce & Plattformen
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Implementierung von Backend- und Frontendsystemen auf Basis von SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) mit Java und Spring unter Einhaltung von Best Practices.

bullets.label: APIs & Integrationen
bullets.text: Konzeption und Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services sowie Aufbau performanter Daten-Pipelines über DataHub und Hotfolders zur reibungslosen Anbindung von PIM- und ERP-Systemen.

bullets.label: Performance & Betrieb
bullets.text: Optimierung von Datenbankabfragen zur Reduzierung von Latenzen sowie Durchführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen und Release-Builds in Cloud-Umgebungen.

bullets.label: Techno-Funktionale Analyse
bullets.text: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachabteilungen und internationalen Stakeholdern zur Anforderungsanalyse, Erstellung von User Stories und Begleitung von Tests.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026. Ein Eintritt ist ab dem 16.12.2026 möglich. Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: CGI stands for large-scale digital transformation and technical excellence across critical industries like aviation and retail. My 5+ years of architecting, integrating, and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms for global clients directly match CGI's commitment to delivering robust, high-performance digital solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and backend engineering experience to drive scalable digital solutions at CGI.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms and backend integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I'm very interested in CGI's digital projects. My CV and cover letter are attached. I'd love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior E-Commerce & Backend Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Developer role at CGI.

With over 5 years of professional experience building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms, REST APIs, and complex integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise and a strong techno-functional background.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving notice with my last working day on 15.12.2026 and available from 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to CGI.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
